CustomField.description: When this run last became Stalled. The chain engine sets it when a run becomes Stalled. Code or a flow that moves a run into Stalled must set it in the same save. A save that runs with the user's permissions, such as a flow in user context, needs edit access on this field, which Kern Administrator has. It is cleared when the run starts running again, and kept when the run ends. The purge of old chain runs uses this time to delete a run that stays Stalled.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this run last became Stalled. Cleared when the run starts running again.
CustomField.label: Stalled At
